map.CAC（Customer Acquisition Cost，客户获取成本）是指企: CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) is the total cost a business spends to win one new customer, including both marketing and sales cost. It is the core measure of acquisition efficiency and profitability.
map.CAC = (营销费用 + 销售费用) / 新增客户数: CAC = (marketing cost + sales cost) / new customers
map.例如：营销费用5万元，销售费用3万元，新增400个客户，则 CAC = (500: For example with marketing cost 50000, sales cost 30000 and 400 new customers, CAC = (50000 + 30000) / 400 = 200 CNY per customer.

map.把营销费+销售费摊到新增客户，算真实获客成本。: Spread marketing plus sales cost over new customers to get the true acquisition cost.
map.结合 LTV 看 CAC 是否健康（LTV:CAC≥3 为佳）。: With LTV, judge whether CAC is healthy (LTV:CAC ≥ 3 is ideal).
map.拆分营销端/销售端 CAC 找费用大头。: Split CAC into marketing and sales sides to find the biggest cost block.
map.营销费 8000、销售费 2000、新增客户 200 → CAC=(8000+2: Marketing cost 8000, sales cost 2000 and 200 new customers gives CAC = (8000+2000)/200 = 50 CNY; marketing-side CAC = 40 and sales-side CAC = 10. With LTV = 3000, LTV:CAC = 60, excellent.
map.CAC=50、LTV=3000（按 36 个月摊）→ 月回收=3000/36≈8: CAC = 50 and LTV = 3000 spread over 36 months gives monthly recovery of 3000/36 ≈ 83 CNY, so payback = 50/83 ≈ 0.6 months, an extremely fast recovery.
map.建议含。只算广告费会低估真实获客成本，尤其高客单价靠销售跟进的业务。: It should. Counting only ad spend understates true acquisition cost, especially for high-ticket businesses that rely on sales follow-up.
